title: Indexed Boolean Fourier numerator
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite set, let $g:\{\pm1\}^{\iota}\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $S\subseteq\iota$. The indexed Boolean Fourier numerator of $g$ at $S$ is $\sum_{x\in\{\pm1\}^{\iota}} g(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: sign-valued function on the indexed sign cube
